name: Push Up (Weighted)
instructions: Place a plate on your upper back or wear a weighted vest.
Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping your body straight.
Press back up to straight arms.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A push-up with added load for progressing chest and triceps strength.

safetyNotes: Use a weighted vest or a spotter for the plate; stop with wrist or shoulder pain.
